data.title: apps/chat tests: gitRunnable() is three byte-identical copies — hoist the runnable-git probe into one shared test helper

data.body: From the AS-84 cycle-3 review (qa-ruben, 2026-09-11, note N1). The runnable-git skip probe gitRunnable() now exists as three byte-identical copies: test/watcher-process.test.js:151 (AS-84), test/deploy-shape.test.js:41 and test/deploy-inputs-git.test.js:45 (AS-86). Each guards tests that must skip as a COUNTED outcome on the git-less compose test image. Three copies drift: a fix to one (e.g. how a present-but-broken git is treated; all three currently skip on status !== 0) can silently miss the others, and the compose suite would go red on only some of them. Do: hoist into one helper (e.g. test/helpers/git-runnable.js), import it from all three sites, keep the skip message identical. Acceptance: the compose --build run still reports 5 skipped / 0 fail; a mutant that makes the helper always return true turns the compose run red on exactly the five guarded tests (AS-84's AC-14 and AC-18 plus the three AS-86 guards); a mutant that removes any one of the three t.skip calls yields the vacuous pass — observed, not argued. Do not add git to the Dockerfile: that is an image-input change and a different decision. Low-priority hygiene; does not gate AS-87/AS-88 but must land after them (same files at the seam).
